output.search_notes: Screening date: 2026-11-03. All qualifying companies verified from opened pages are included; this is not an exhaustive census. Employee estimates are published total-workforce figures, not counts of social-network profiles. Undated pages are identified explicitly: the review date is not the measurement date. Worldwide figures are labelled; FOOKE publishes a Borken-site figure. Family-business descriptions support the ownership classifications but are not substitutes for shareholder-register due diligence. No PE-backed company has been knowingly included; the reviewed ownership evidence did not identify a PE sponsor, so there was no identified sponsor portfolio to cross-check. Funding rounds were not verified: last_round is null for every company, not a claim that no financing occurred. Two genuinely dated, comparable workforce counts were not established: headcount_growth is null throughout. Missing_fields for every company: headcount_growth, last_round; ELHA additionally founded_year. HQ states are omitted where not stated on the opened page. Traction includes qualitative company statements where no dated revenue or named-customer evidence was established. Other discovered candidates were not promoted to qualifying status when ownership or total headcount remained unresolved; in particular social-profile counts were not used to qualify larger groups. Corporate subsidiaries were not treated as family-owned solely because their parent might be family-owned.
